title: Referrals and Authorizations Policy Manual: Holding Several Authorizations at Once
content:
**Referrals and Authorizations** are issued per patient, and this chapter of the policy manual records the holding rule for requests received by the region.

## Clause 1 (no longer in force)

> A patient may hold any number of referrals and authorizations at once, of the same or different types, so long as no two of them are duplicates under the duplicate rule.

This clause is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as the earlier text of the holding rule; it is not applied to any request.

## Clause 2. Per-patient figure

The holding rule sets no per-patient maximum figure: the product carries no numeric cap on the count of referrals and authorizations one patient holds.
